name: Andrew Michael Bayley
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Houston, Texas
education: South Texas College of Law Houston
about: Andrew Michael Bayley is the lead attorney at The Bayley Law Firm, located in Houston, Texas. Focusing on family law, divorce, mediation, custody and child support, he has built a reputation for providing effective legal solutions to individuals and families throughout Houston, Montgomery County, Harris County and Fort Bend County.

Mr. Bayley graduated from Western Illinois University with a Bachelor of Science degree in 2006 and earned his Juris Doctor from South Texas College of Law Houston in 2009. Since beginning his legal career in 2010, he has assisted numerous clients with their legal needs, not only in family law but also in real estate law, business litigation and small business support. His courtroom experience is extensive, having appeared before nearly every sitting district court judge in Harris County and the surrounding counties. Additionally, he has argued cases in the First and Fourteenth Courts of Appeals.

Growing up in St. Louis, Missouri, Mr. Bayley gained valuable insights into customer service and business management while working for his father. This experience instilled in him the importance of going the extra mile for clients, a principle he upholds in his legal practice. His commitment to client satisfaction is evident, as he strives to ensure that every client of his remains a lifelong client.

In 2019, Mr. Bayley achieved board certification in family law from the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Whether dealing with intricate divorce proceedings, navigating custody arrangements or resolving child support issues, clients can rely on his strategic approach and compassionate support. His dedication to resolving disputes amicably through mediation, when possible, reflects his belief in minimizing conflict for the benefit of all parties involved. This client-centered approach ensures that individuals receive not only experienced legal counsel but also the peace of mind that comes with knowing their interests are being thoroughly protected.
